explanation: A prophet who is asked to curse the Israelites, but God instructs him not to do so.
The king of Moab who asks Balaam to curse the Israelites out of fear that they will invade his land.
God's chosen people who are on their way to the promised land after being led out of Egypt.
The animal Balaam rides, which sees an angel and refuses to move forward. The donkey is given the ability to speak by God and confronts Balaam.
A divine messenger sent by God to prevent Balaam from cursing the Israelites.
A negative force or unfavorable situation that Balak wants Balaam to bring upon the Israelites.
The opposite of a curse; Balaam ends up blessing the Israelites instead of cursing them.
